item.title: The Latest: Iran receives 15-point ceasefire proposal from US, Pakistan officials say
item.description: Pakistani officials say Iran has received a 15-point proposal from the U.S. to reach a ceasefire in the Iran war. The Trump administration reportedly offered the plan to Iran as the U.S. appears to seek an end to the war even while more troops head to the Middle East. A person who spoke on condition of anonymity says the plan was submitted to Iran by intermediaries from Pakistan, which has offered to host negotiations between Washington and Tehran.
